heading_en: Transitional Measures for Capital Instruments of Ultimate Designated Parent Companies
summary_ja: 適用日前に発行されたTier2資本調達手段及び適格旧Tier2資本調達手段については、なお従前の例による。
summary_en: Provides that Tier 2 Capital instruments and Qualifying Former Tier 2 Capital Instruments issued before the Application Date remain subject to the previous rules, notwithstanding the new Article 7, paragraph (5).
paragraphs: Notwithstanding Article 7, paragraph (5) of the Public Notice Establishing Standards for Determining Whether the Capital Adequacy Status of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc. Is Appropriate in Light of the Assets, etc. Held by Such Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc., as amended by the provisions of Article 5 (referred to as the "New Ultimate Designated Parent Company Notice" in Article 26 of the Supplementary Provisions), with respect to those of the Tier 2 Capital instruments (meaning the Tier 2 Capital instruments prescribed in Article 7, paragraph (4) of the Public Notice Establishing Standards for Determining Whether the Capital Adequacy Status of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc. Is Appropriate in Light of the Assets, etc. Held by Such Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc., before amendment by the provisions of Article 5) and the Qualifying Former Tier 2 Capital Instruments (meaning the Qualifying Former Tier 2 Capital Instruments prescribed in Article 3, paragraph (2) of the Supplementary Provisions of the Public Notice Partially Amending the Public Notice Establishing Standards for Determining Whether the Capital Adequacy Status of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc. Is Appropriate in Light of the Assets, etc. Held by Such Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc. (FSA Public Notice No. 29 of 2012; referred to as the "2012 Amended Ultimate Designated Parent Company Notice" in Article 31 of the Supplementary Provisions)) that were issued before the Application Date, the previous practice remains applicable.

terms.en: New Ultimate Designated Parent Company Notice
